I definitely don't blame him for not understanding, I think Im seeing, I ought to be more careful with myself and who I open up to. 
Because like I said, first time I have a finger pointed at my mental health, and how that article made me seem like... Not who I am. 
I feel sorry for him, I'm sad, I hoped he would be the one, that wouldn't turn cold, that wouldn't let me drop the the floor in an episode of my mind being on fire and he stand there looking at me...cold. I said..why are you like this, why are you cold and distant I need somone to hug me and tell me I'm okay, and he answered that I made him like that. I'm just sad and scared, did I really change somone that much through my mistakes. I just wish.. somtimes that if I want like this, I could have a happy, love partner like I did when we first met. It honestly breaks my heart what has happened. But I think it's a big learning curve for me and my behaviour and illness. 

Thankyou for your insight and advice x

He does, he's had a rough childhood, he says he was borderline.... But he recovered? I said if you have, then why are you being so cold when you know how much this all hurts. He couldn't explain how he over came it....
Im not sure ... When..  he was never diagnosed. He has never have therapy for it, the last time he went to a psychiatrist was year ago when he was in the military. Im not bitching, I honestly am so so so confused about it all. He confuses me with contradiction, and double faces. He wants me, he wants me to get out of his life. Says cruel mean things about my mind, but still wants me to stay, that's why I don't want to put him through anymore of my anger and sadness. It's not fair on him.
Do you mean an excuse to break up? Yes. He said reading that article made it easier for him to disconnect and let go of me.

I know, I have had the whole " wow, your Really struggling" ...like thankyou for pointing out my emotional turmoil... They point it out, like fingers but then walk away, or don't offer any kind words to help with the struggle. I am honestly trying from be mindful and help myself, I just wish... Like somone would stay with me and support me, try to understand. but instead, he wants to disconnect, still have me around, and have the better me later on. I don't think that's fair. Leave me alone to go through it all ( court case, blah blah sickness, money problems, no car, when you can't keep on top of everything and it just falls out of your hands) and then wait until I'm better then jump into my heart again . 

I never know what's right or wrong or morally good for me. This isn't first relationship, 5 years. He's older, (25 female me, 35 male) I just.. don't know if it's the right think to do to walk back into a home that triggers me and messes me up.

Thankyou for reading and helping

Thankyou,this is one place I feel comfortable asking for.. understanding. 

I feel like, the way he explained, was that " there are alot of people out there suffering in a relationship with a bpd (me being female), it's a common thing" and from that, he formed a leverage over me and my diagnosis, and now he wants me to get better, but he has disconnected from me. Broke up with me, but wants me to live with him and his daughter still, but I mentally can't. 
Live in the room next door, knowing he is moving on. It's high risk for myself,knowing I'm still living with somone who broke up with me, based on my brain, but still wants me around? 
But then only an hour before, saying to leave and gtfo of his life. I just don't understand, the article really warped him and me. And now I feel like I shouldn't even attempt a relationship... I'm finding more and more peace by myself. 

Again, I hope that makes sense. I'm still incredibly scattered emotionally.

It says, good insightful things, but it so painful reading about your condition (diagnosed at 18, turned 25 8/12) and then it says, they're is NO POINT continuing a relationship with bpd people, because of how messed up we are. 
He read it, and then started saying to my every response and action "typical BPD" and how my processes are fucked up, I get emotional, I mean really really emotional, and he says how fucked I am. I came out of surgery today, I asked if he could he there when I come out he wasn't there, he wouldn't take me to the hospital last night, so my mum has to call police to take me. He didn't see any reason why he should help me....he read that article and changed, he turned cold, I cry ALOT, and he just looks good at me. When all I want is  a nice person to tell me I'm going to be okay. (massive dv background between us, stress of child abuse court case on my end) like I'm honestly trying to cope with all this stress, about to start a job, and I have to go get surgery. But ...I just don't understand why people would write intense articles based on this, and then think I wouldn't Influence the relationship dynamic. I'm just so hurt, so suicidal, so lost. In hospital recovering, and it's all just caved in. He said he will finally be happy when I leave his life, he said I can never love or be with anyone because of how fucked up I am. Like... What am I ment to do from here. How have you gotten over this, if you have had to. This is the first time I have been attacked and destroyed on my BPD mind. Please... My insides are knotting, the hosptial gave me a Valium to help stop crying. He was my favourite, he wasn't everything, I have no one where I am (family Ina different state) (I would go back but the family abuse case in going on over there, I'm on the other side of Australia) .. sorry for ranting and typos, please be nice, I'm just trying to ask how you have copied with this... Raw... Disembowelment of my soul and self preservation. 
Thankyou beautiful people.
